summaryZh: Shi group 开发和应用多模态显微及光谱技术，研究衰老与疾病中的代谢动态。研究平台用于原位绘制细胞代谢活动，并观察新合成分子的空间分布。

evidence.quote: Shi Lab Principal Investigator: Lingyan Shi

The Shi group is developing and applying laser scanning multimodal microscopy and spectroscopic technologies -- this includes stimulated Raman scattering (SRS) spectroscopy, multiphoton fluorescence microscopy (MPF), and second harmonic generation (SHG) for studying metabolic dynamics during aging and diseases.
The imaging platform is used to map in situ cellular metabolic activities, and visualize the spatial distribution of newly synthesized molecules
